review: summary: "Fire Commissioner" is a single office (a person), but "la comisión de bomberos" renders it as a commission (a body); the meaning changes from one commissioner's discussion topics to a commission's.; items 5: "Fire Commissioner" is a single office, but "la comisión de bomberos" renders it as a commission (a body).
